summary: The change removes non-expiring agent grants: lifetimes are clamped to 1-365 days with finite KV expiry, the year-9999 sentinel is treated as expired, and exchange, touch, label edit and listing reject expired records. Tests cover zero, negative, missing, oversized and legacy sentinel lifetimes.

evidence: `src/auth_store.ts` clamps every `createAgentToken` lifetime to a finite default or `agentTokenMaxTtlMs` and always writes the same absolute expiry and KV `expireIn` to both indexes.

`src/auth_config.ts` normalizes zero, negative, missing and oversized `ttlDays` to a bounded finite value; `src/passport.ts` passes only finite request lifetimes through device start, approval and exchange.
`src/auth_store.ts` treats the year-9999 sentinel and any invalid or past `expiresAt` as expired, with exchange, touch, label edit and listing rejecting them and removing both indexes lazily.
`tests/bun_test.ts`, `src/config_test.ts` and `src/store_test.ts` add cases for zero, negative, missing, oversized and legacy non-expiring credentials, proving they cannot remain usable forever.
